# Qualification and risk register

All49 rows in accepted-input-qualification-preservation-matrix.json are retained without closure or relaxed language:25 inherited qualifications;8 extra crosswalk restrictions;8 V-R risks;8 AC conditions. Full verbatim source sections are copied with accepted-input prefixes and authenticated to014A. These are not49 independent audit defects. Historical source-authority map protects all20 owners. No design can override an original owner gate or upgrade a qualified claim.

A26-Q01 stays OPEN admissionfairness; A26C-L01 stays OPEN LOW requestpagination. F05 Windows/openhandles and F06 production/powerloss durability stay unqualified. T01 trusted honest terminating owners/repositories/certificates, trustedroot and singlewriter remain; M02 currentregistry nothistoricalmembership. O-C01 compoundoutcomes and O-C02 historicalACK/currentreadiness remain. Q01-A canonicalrepresentation and old C072failure preserved. E-T01 accepted unchanged2worker/timeouts; no hosted execution guarantee. Qualified V-R01–V-R08 remain design risks, not resolved. AC01–08 constrain one receipt/one floor, conserved attempts/budgets/debt, unestablishedconsistency, immutable P26plans, OPENlimitations, P28exclusivefuturestates, disableddefaultdispatch/genuineauthority and preservation.
